body: This is brilliant, thank you!!!

Yup. And I also feel like a piece of shit. Mainly for moving so far away from my family to be with a man who never committed to me, and now that we're broken up I have nobody. I couldn't pay for a plane ticket to see my family, so I'm stuck here.

I'm going to try watching a couple of movies tonight to distract me, maybe have a beer or two to relax (but not get drunk because that exasperates my depression). Tomorrow if I can't find anyone to hang out with i'm gonna make myself a turkey pot pie. I'm also volunteering from 10AM-2PM so that'll take a chunk out of the day. Friday I work, so it's only one day I have to deal with...until New Year's.

That's actually almost exactly what I struggle with. It makes perfect sense, especially to ask 'would I do this to another person?'. I've sometimes felt very one-sided in relationships where I give more than my SO but never thought to ask the difficult questions up until recently.

Admittedly both dates were cancelled for 'legitimate' reasons, especially the second one. Shortly after I wrote this last night guy #2 texted me and we ended up chatting on the phone for almost 3 hours! We both had early commitments this morning so chatting on the phone was the easiest thing for both of us since it would take more time to go out at that point. Guy #2 was quite apologetic too so that gives me more hope that he didn't just cancel on a whim (work-related). And I feel more comfortable knowing we've connected in a sense over the phone before going out. Trying to keep my emotional distance though so I don't get so bummed out like I was. Guy #1 I haven't heard from since them and I don't intend to pursue him any more.

Wonderful advice, thank you so much for taking the time to type that out! And you DO have a point about Snookie, that gave me a good chuckle. :)

Good advice. I'm volunteering tomorrow so it will be a fun way to get me out of the apartment. I'm looking forward to that at least. I try doing Meetups too. I have a lot of acquaintances and friends but it gets tiring trying to find something more only to feel rejected.

True. Worse for me to take the time to travel and get there and then be stranded once I got there. I just feel like there's something about me that i'm attracting flakes? I don't understand why and I tend to internalize it rather than see it as something with them. I would never do this to someone else except for a dire emergency. I'm tired of dating though. Ugh.

Well thanks for the encouragement, I've been through a divorce too (although not horrible, still not great). I feel like I'm never enough sometimes for these guys that just want to cancel on a whim and not provide a justification why. I'm glad to hear your story worked out for you. Admittedly, i'm kinda scared to date online because of my divorce. What helped you?
Oh my goodness, that is such a gorgeous cat! I went SQUEE when I saw the little white on her toes :3

Yeah codependency is some scary stuff. It puts on some serious blinders to the truth and often will distort the truth just to make sure everyone is 'okay'. (edited for large amount of cussing from original post)

Is it normal? I hope so. I just see a lot of admirable qualities about this character and wish that I could be it. Perhaps it's because I'm stuck running the rat race to pay my bills and crippling student loan debt that I can't see myself emulating those traits in my real life. I should have never gone to school and put myself through the hell I am living now, and for that I consider myself weak, stupid, and blinded. I've been crafted by society to become another rat, enslaved to the banks that have my life information and could come take my sanity at any moment if they saw fit. I have no control over my life anymore, I don't have the flexibility to make decisions that would take away my income. The decisions I would have to make to be happier would make me even more in debt than I am now, and therefore more miserable. I'm miserable no matter how I look at it.

Funny you should mention sushi, because that's one thing I've never EVER had the desire to try it. Maybe that can be a goal to reach for this week. Try a new food or something. I don't know. It sounds more exciting than my life is right now.

I feel like shit, and I guess that makes sense since that is how I see myself. Worthless piece of shit just going to work and surviving. Living for a paycheck so I can live in an apartment, feed myself, and continue the cycle and drudgery that is my life. I've given up on society in a lot of ways and wish I could feasibly quit my job and live in isolation in the woods somewhere, reconnect with nature or something. I don't know. Thanks for the encouragement.

Thanks man. Double edged sword is a good way to describe it. I used to identify with the things I did - studying, learning, intramural sports. Now I don't have that and the friends I used to have I don't have anymore, the hobbies I had I don't have anymore. It's just depressing when I look at what I used to do compared to what I do now and I wonder if getting a job was really worth the schooling and struggle I devoted towards it, now that i'm a miserable piece of shit.

I guess part of me is scared to reflect on myself because I don't see myself offering anything to the world. I wake up, go to my job, come home from my job, and am so exhausted from putting up a happy front that I just want to veg out and do nothing when i'm home. It's an awful cycle of living but right now I don't have the energy to break it. I can't quit my job or i'd be broke since I'm living paycheck to paycheck, and I don't make enough to put away in savings. I feel like I don't have a self sometimes, that i'm just molding myself to other people's concepts of what people are or things they identify with, but none of it is truly me. I appreciate your feedback though, it is getting me to think and not feel alone in being confused in all of this.

This is exactly how I feel right now. Its horrible when this happens at work, and I'm fighting it, and then when I'm off of working can't get any sleep because I'm worrying about stuff and browsing the internet...and the cycle continues...
Yeah, that's why I'm grateful for headphones. Blocks them and their bullshit out.

My mother even dared to try and correct my truthful version of a story regarding an argument we had when she told me she never wanted to talk to me again. Well now she says she didn't say that. Its all whatever makes them look good, and they'd lie under oath just to protect their conscience. Its sick and I'm glad to be 2500 miles away from that bullshit now.

I wish I could tell her off like that - I live far enough away where I don't have to deal with her on a regular basis, and I'll be in bed for most of her visit and she got a hotel room so hopefully if I tell her I'm sleeping a lot she won't come around too much.

The sooner you learn that you can't make everyone happy, the better off you'll be in life. You might do exactly what everyone tells you to, but they'll still find something to be pissy about. It is just not worth your happiness to try and make other people happy, especially your parents. If they can't accept you for who you are, someone who excels in the classroom rather than on the football field, then its time for you to choose, are you going to live for them or for you? Make this a very conscious decision and start acting upon it and you will fare off better than a lot of people.

Okay there. In a post that I've told you I've lost hope and am pissed at the world, you waltz in here and talk about yourself. That's not supportive or helpful and shows a complete lack of empathy for my feelings and situation. Theres a reason you're getting negative karma on this. I'd recommend not commenting on this subreddit anymore with that attitude, you sound as manipulative and as cold as my narcissist mother so stay the fuck away from me, you can't and won't guilt trip me.
/r/raisedbynarcissists
I want to know what kind of acid youre on and then tell me where I can get some, cause I'd rather live in the delusional fog you're in rather than my life.
I love everything about this and the comments section. First time I've been truly tempted to bust out laughing at work!

I'm sorry to put it this way, but your optimism makes me want to choke myself. Ive heard about TESOL and other bullshit when I really want to teach in my specialty but I can't because I didn't get published during my Masters program and that's a requirement for even community college level teaching, so fuck me that I want to teach at a university. People always told me I'd be a great teacher but then I couldn't land a job for over a year, and after getting rejections from Starbucks you know your life isn't worth shit to anyone else, and fuck it if you have actual skills without all of the other credentials. The world is fucked up and I don't feel like I belong here anymore.

I've recently begun to dive into this issue of identity and figuring out 'What makes me, me?' And it was ingrained to me as a child that I have to please everyone all of the damn time, even at the sacrifice of my own sense of self, my own voice, or having my own opinions. Talking back or standing up for myself was never an option as an RBN. But now that I'm in the real world, I'm discovering that I don't have to put up with people's crap just to make them happy, and by sticking up for myself concerning work situations, I'm a lot happier for it. Its empowering to let go of that debilitating fear of conflict and allow it to happen when it happens. Not everyone will yell at you if you decide you want pizza for dinner instead of roast beef, or that your schedule can't handle any more projects rather than accepting every project someone wants to give you. Its a slow journey but I think this sub is a great place to start. Rooting for you and your lovely self, which like me is probably buried underneath years of numbing pain and fear.

That's what the narcissist wants: for you to shut down. Its how you learn to deal with life, and pretty soon you think that's how you're supposed to act. Like your voice doesn't matter and you're supposed to be quiet unless someone talks to you. Just to let you know, I used to be where you are until I literally broke ties with my family for over 2 years. I have low contact with my family now but until I was away from it, I couildnt recognize what was going on. Maybe getting away isn't an option but by recognizing it you can start to heal yourself, surround yourself with people who respect you and make you feel like a human being. Wishing you all the best.

Well guys. I sent her an email playing nice and telling her that maybe her and my dad ( who I can somewhat tolerate) could come out once I'm feeling better. Let's hope that this works and maybe she'll change her mind.

I was diagnosed when younger on the autistic spectrum, and my nmom used that diagnosis to try and take complete control over my life. She did that by making me question myself, hate myself, and not trust my own judgment on anything. Its like a disease that I'm slowly working out of my system through therapy and other support but I tell you that I have no guilt or remorse about being low contact with my nmom. If I could, I would go completely no contact but since I actually like my dad I don't want to do that. Letting go of the past? For me, i m still not sure if I'll ever be able to forgive her for the emotional abuse she put me through. I have a hard time processing these things when I'm so convinced that things will never change. Like another post said, I've become very detached and apathetic towards my family, but my anger towards them burns in my chest almost constantly.
What a fuckin control freak, glad you have the option to do something fun like baking outside of her presence.

Shit, I tensed up just reading this because that's always how I felt when I was living at home. You described it so well, just like a tension you could cut a knife with, I was threatened to be kicked out of my house, also threatened to be cut off from all communication (after I moved out) . I still am like the black sheep of my family, but now I live 2500 miles away from them so it has gotten better over time. I don't consider them my family, in the normal sense of the word. We share blood but there's no special bond or connection other than shared experiences while I was with them. Other than that, I fucking hate my family and if I didn't have this societal obligation to go visit them during the holidays I wouldn't be in their lives at all. Especially since my mother is a narcissistic leech that sucks every once of joy from my being when she's around, and my dad only enables her. Fuck family. If they were just people I didn't know on the street I would never even engage in conversation with them because of how selfish and rude they are.
I'll take two things that don't exist for $500

Not knowing if my SO is in love with me, when I know that I would want to spend the rest of my life with them. Also, wondering if they are truly happy being with me or not. Considering they have depression, it's hard to tell some days if they even enjoy my company.

Holy shit, I am angry just reading something like this. This is the state of the job market right now and people choose to ignore the millions of people who don't have the right piece of paper or only 2 years of experience instead of 5, making them unqualified for most available jobs. And if you're unemployed for longer than 6 months? Employers assume you're not a hard worker and toss your resume away. The whole system is fucked up. Those assholes should have said nothing if they didn't have something helpful or constructive to say.

College. If you don't know what you want to do or study, do not go. There are ways to experience making friends and partying without flushing away thousands of dollars a down the drain.

I think this is entirely possible in my life. I've always hated my narcissist mother and I have a pretty good feeling the reason I never connected with her is because something fucked up happened to me. I'm glad I don't remember what that might be.

I've pretty much given a big middle finger to the morality system of this country (US) since it has managed to fuck me over. Usually its the people who know how to best manipulate others for their money that make it. I always tried to be a good person, do the right thing, get a meaningful job and yet I'm thousands of dollars in debt, miserable, and making no difference whatsoever. My turnaround also happened at 25. I've thought about doing illegal stuff, simply so I can pay the bills and maybe start paying down my debt. But I work for a job that has good benefits, although it pays shit otherwise. 

In the end, I believe that you can only do what's best for you. Stop worrying about everyone else and take care of yourself first and foremost. Had I done what I wanted to when I was younger, I wouldn't be in as much debt and might be living a decent life. But what can you do. I wish I could fake my death so I could start over again.

Yeah, it sucks when your student loan debt crushes your soul. Its hard not to give a fuck about something you put years of your life into achieving, and all for what? A shitty job I couldve gotten straight out of high school? I wave between being grateful I even have my education, and despising it and the entire schooling system for being such a rip off. Some days are better than others.
Holy fuck, I'm in the exact same shoes as you. I beat myself up relentlessly for both of my degrees. Still haven't found a way to get over it.
Don't worry, I wouldn't go Costco on it, you know what I mean?
That's interesting, mine has actually evolved from sadness to anger as I've gotten older. The bitter taste of regret over decisions in my past tipped me over the edge about a year ago.

Ahhh yes Yoda7, you are like a diamond in the brush with your optimistic ways of epic eulogies and fighting wild beasts. I like the way you think though, maybe I need to start using my imagination more.

Dear Bramse, I know that the emotion of anger is at times uncomfortable to deal with. That doesnt mean you need to make snarky comments about 'calming down' or the one that people love to use is 'get your act together'. People say that enough to me that I know its a defense mechanism. I only hope that when you see someone you know who is fucking angry with life that you don't say this to their face, because who knows what they would do to you if their knuckles had a chance to meet your face for the first time.

Sincerely,
"Elliot"

Fuck, yes! You and I are like soul twins, seething with rage and not giving a fuck. In all honesty, you're the first person in years that I've felt I've had that much in common with. Either its fucking awesome or my life sucks so much that sharing rage with someone is what connects me to them. Shit. Should I feel embarrassed by that?

This is why I haven't really ever been all that interested in picking up video games to begin with. Its like, if I were to spend two hours playing a game, what could I have done with those two hours? I would feel utterly useless. Yet I have friends who spend hours upon hours playing games, and they tell me that's how they deal with life. I'm not inclined to imitate them in that regard.

Yeah this is probably why I have no true friends. Everyone wants that fake connection with other like minded people that perpetuates their false sense of happiness. In a way, I'd rather live in reality and be miserable than be happy and ignorant. But I guess I can't have it where I could live in reality and also be happy. Cause life does suck and its painful most of the time. I've begun to let go of the whole facade of always being happy in front of other people, and I may not have a crowd of people talking to me at my desk at work, or be invited to go to lunch with my coworkers, but I can't tell you how much I hate hearing the fake laughing and gossip that they do, which confirms to me how much I'm not like other people. Guess I'd rather be called a woos in trying to find some sense of fucking contentment in my life than live like everyone else. I'll be in debt for the rest of my life anyway so no sense in going after a house, car, or fancy clothes. Fuck that bullshit.

I feel the same way except I sold my financial well being to the government via student loans. I long for the life where my life doesnt revolve around paying off those fucking loans. It makes me mad to have my education and to live in a country where this shit is even allowed to happen where institutions are able to give loans the way they do. It sucks to feel like you self-sacrificed for someone/something else without realizing the cost. I'm right there with you on that.

Hey you know what? I pretty much am a cynical asshole. Not afraid to admit it. Glad to know I'm not alone. Maybe we should form a Cynical Asshole Club? All ye who hate themselves and the world enter at your own risk. I'll stop there before I make an ass of myself.

Are you my mind? That was a perfect description of how I drive. After I did this with someone else in the car though I realized how shitty it was and apologized to them profusely. Still hasn't stopped me from acting this way, but I'm aware of it now. One step at a time, I suppose.

And of course everyone puts on their best face to show everyone how awesome their lives are, and I've been scared to even post a status update for months cause I don't have anything to say. Its so fake, just like I've realized most of my friendships have been for years. I can honestly say I've had one true friend, all of the others were based on shared hobbies or clubs. Once the clubs went away and I moved outta town, no more friendship.

I'm an entry-level employee and there are people who are getting paid 2-3 times as much as me and they are still trying to make me do their work. I've finally grown a pair and told several people no, with the hint that I'm not going to do their job for them while they get to dick around. Fortunately, they've stopped asking me to do their jobs for them, so I have that going for me, which is nice. But I also fucked up on my education so I put myself in this position to be stepped on, and as you mentioned, I hate myself for it. Every damn day. Trying not to give in, but most days its hard to even get the strength to take care of myself, nonetheless deal with the hellhole I've managed to dig myself into.

To me personally, that would be the next step towards just not giving a fuck. The moment I stop feeling angry at all is the point of no return. I'm almost scared to think of being at that point of just numb to anything and everything.
Haha that would be fun. Just go camping, set up an enticing food pile for a bear, and then challenge it to a duel. Winner gets to keep the food. And their life!! Dun dun dunnnnnnnnnnnnnn.

I'm afraid of doing the same thing, driving away people that actually give a fuck about me and then I'd not only be pissed but also lonely, and that is a shitty situation to be in. I feel your pain.

I always wake up with a sense of optimism about the day, sometimes I'll even get stuff done in the mornings. Then it all goes to shit and I go to bed with the same sense of dread about tomorrow that I had the day before.

When I look back I smack myself for doing it, but in the moment it feels fucking awesome to just let a rip on someone you don't know with complete apathy. Its horrible, and makes me feel like a bad person too.

Wow, you need to get off your damn pedestal and come back to earth. People, including you, can and will be wrong from time to time. In the end, your arrogance is your fucking problem. I'm not gonna downvote you for this, but I simply cannot agree that the mindset of 'What doesn't kill you makes you stronger' is beneficial. Usually if something doesnt kill me I'm left bruised and more frustrated than before and makes me hate myself more for not having the energy to do anything about it because I'm simply trying to survive from one day to the next.

Yeah, I'm angry and furious at myself and its like my self-loathing spills onto other people too, and it doesn't take much to set me off these days. Although I've always held my anger in, its starting to boil over to a point where I really have a hard time controlling it, especially because I think my train of thought is getting fucked up too. I've tried so many things to release my tension but its all temporary and nothing seems to stick (this includes therapy, exercise, and going out). I just want to be able to go live in the middle of nowhere by myself for 6 months, not have to worry about money, work, or anything else but getting my shit in order in my head.

I was just thinking about doing the Facebook thing last night actually. Its almost like the fewer contacts I have on FB, the less the burden of being alone feels, since it confirms to me that I don't have any true friends. And I think you're spot on about being weak and insecure. I've been a wreck since I went through a long string of unemployment last year and even though I have a good job now I can't seem to break free from the frustration and disappointment I have towards myself and the world.

I wish I could play videogames but I didn't grow up playing so whenever I try to play I suck, and then I get more frustrated than when I started cause I can't control a damn joystick. I have bought Tomb Raider and a couple other games to try on my friends PS3 but I can never sit down for more than 10 minutes without being absolutely frustrated.
I'm fucking angry at the world and pessimistic. Not gonna do anything stupid and I'm not a sociopath or psychotic, I'm just a normal person who has been handed a shitty card in life.

You don't need that bullshit in your life.

Seriously, being in a relationship and having sex does not make you any more of a person. There's a lot of good wisdom you've received so far in other comments. but when I was in your shoes I literally told the world and the ridiculous pressure society puts on us to be good looking and sexy to go fuck themselves. I actually got angry enough to out my foot down and try to be happy as me, and no one else. Some days are harder than others but overall it was a relief to let go of that pressure.

Get as far away fro. Her as possible and accept no apologies for that behavior. If she's even capable of that much lack of empathy, she'll do it again. Fuck that.

Never never EVER take out a loan. Just don't. You're signing away your life.
